text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I brought Believe, who wasn't feeling her best, to a shrine to pray.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to trouble you.
It's just... I'm really not in the mood...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Being in a slump is my own responsibility...
And yet, here I am, relying on divine intervention..."
choice_data_list: Come on, don't beat yourself up like that.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That's right, Believe-san.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Durandal-san.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
How about thinking of it like this?
Instead of relying on God—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Make a vow"
that you will bounce back.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Making a vow... I see.
Very well."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If it's about conveying your aspirations,
that might be a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. As they say, constant dripping wears away the stone.
With the determination that I will definitely get back on my feet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believe prays with absolute focus.
Will she receive the divine blessing—?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
How... is it, Durandal-san?
I've reset my mindset... but do I look any different to you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: A shiver... runs down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh, my height?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, when you were in top form, you had an intensity
like a master blacksmith forging a holy sword.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: It's back in your eyes—that sparkle.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
ââ!?
...Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go forward without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believe had sorted out her mind and body,
and caught the momentum she needed for a comeback!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I don't... feel much has changed.
I suppose simply praying wouldn't do much...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*, perhaps the way you're praying is flawed.
I shall demonstrate, so repeat after me."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Repeat it... yes...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Well then—I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My name is Knight Durandal!
Before the presence of God, I swear upon this holy sword!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Please repeat that.
Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Um... Err, excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...There's no way Believe could say something
so dramatic like that.
Her condition hadn't really changed either."
